q: Did they keep a proper held-out test set for the model?
hint: Look for train / validation / test split, no leakage of test into tuning.

q: Did they rule out data leakage (patients, scanners, time)?
hint: Same patient or site in train and test inflates performance.

q: Is there external validation on an independent cohort?
hint: Single-centre only = higher risk of overfitting.

q: Are the metrics appropriate with confidence intervals?
hint: AUC / sensitivity / specificity / calibration — with CIs, not point estimates alone.

q: Did they compare against a sensible baseline or clinicians?
hint: No baseline makes claimed gains uninterpretable.

q: Are data, code and model details shared enough to reproduce?
hint: Dataset access, preprocessing, hyperparameters, random seeds.

q: Did they analyse failures, subgroups and fairness?
hint: Error cases, subgroup performance, bias across sex / age / site.

q: Do the clinical claims match what was actually tested?
hint: Watch for overreach from retrospective AUC to bedside benefit.
